meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会主持一场只读站会：把你选中的 git worktree、分支或 PR 当作各自独立的 agent 放进一个共享房间，按轮次讨论，最后给出一个整合方案并用大白话讲给你听。
howto.when: 当你要对比多个 worktree、分支或 PR 的改动、想把它们合并成一个时触发。房间是只读的，它只负责谈出方案，真正的合并交给 /do。

say.text: 给我开一场站会，比较最近 4 小时活跃的 worktree
say.note: 它会先列候选名单让你确认

say.text: 把这些分支和这个 PR 一起加进站会房间
say.note: 每个 agent 每轮发言一次

say.text: 用大白话告诉我结论，以及需要我拍板的地方

howto.what_en: After install, Claude runs a read-only standup: each chosen worktree, branch, or PR joins a shared markdown room as an agent, talks in rounds, and Claude returns one consolidation plan plus a plain-language summary.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want several worktrees, branches, or PRs compared and folded into one plan. The room is read-only; the actual merges are handed to /do.

say_en.text: Open a standup over worktrees active in the last 4 hours
say_en.note: It lists candidates for you to confirm first

say_en.text: Add these branches and this PR to the standup room
say_en.note: Each agent speaks once per round

say_en.text: Tell me the outcome in plain language and what's my call
say_en.note: It translates the SUMMATION; no git writes
